description: This is a Java source file defining a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController. It provides basic endpoints for a notes backend service, including a welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: REST controller for handling basic endpoints such as welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and info for the notes backend.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when the root URL is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects incoming requests from /docs to the Swagger UI page, preserving request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating the health status of the application.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides basic information about the application.
